validity_findings.finding: Headline leakage 0.21-0.285 is protocol-mix dependent, not intrinsic site constant. Per-type stratification is perfectly separated on every SPA: link_click 1.00 (170/170 valid), button_click 0.00 (142/142), form_submit 0.00 (210/210), js_navigate 0.00 (105/105). Normalized URL entropy 0.0 bits on all SPAs (single normalized URL; fragment stripped per frozen definition).

validity_findings.finding: document.title constant within each SPA variant across all 168 raw transitions (unique_titles=1, entropy 0.0). Pipeline validated by same code recording 5 distinct Wikipedia titles (HTML, Web browser, World Wide Web, HTTP, URL) with entropy 2.32 bits, ruling out measurement failure.

Frozen normalization strips fragment before comparison (prereg sec 8). All SPA filter links (#/active, #/completed) normalize to the same base path as url_after, so link_click leakage is 1.00 by definition on both SPA and MPA. Leakage variation across experiments therefore measures action-type mix, not site hash-routing benefit alone.

All-raw leakage identical 0.25 (42/168) on all 5 SPA variants; valid-only 0.2846 on 4/5 variants and 0.213 on vue (23/108). Uniformity reflects deterministic 24-action protocol (27% link clicks) replicated identically, not independent site measurement. Vue lower rate due to higher error exclusion (60 errors vs 38).

Primary uses valid-only (errors excluded); all-raw sensitivity 0.25 never crosses 0.40 threshold. 22.6-35.7% error rate (failed toggle/destroy/filter on empty views) disclosed and preserved; exclusion raises leakage 0.25->0.21-0.285 without changing viability decision.

Wikipedia raw_wikipedia.json session 0 Main_Page hub 0/20 successes (no article links discovery failure) superseded by HTML hub rerun 20/20; both artifacts preserved. Final wikipedia n_valid=100 is 5x20 link clicks only, hence 1.00 leakage consistent with parent 0.912 mixed baseline.

Frozen minimums exceeded: 7 sessions x24=168 raw per SPA vs >=5/>=100, wiki 5x20=100; valid counts 130 (4 variants) /108 (vue) still >=100 valid except vue borderline but raw meets threshold. Zero EPIPE crashes across 40 sessions with per-session browser lifecycle mitigation.

TodoMVC demos are not production SPAs (no auth, single input.new-todo, hash routing only, history routing untested). Generalization to production SPAs untested, acknowledged in validity_notes and unresolved.

claim_ceiling: Hash-SPA TodoMVC leakage 0.21-0.28 valid-only (0.25 all-raw) on the frozen 24-action protocol (27% link clicks; link 1.00 vs non-link 0.00 by fragment-stripping definition) – 5/5 variants <40%, achievable NL 357-394 at 500 raw (50 NL needs 64-70 raw). Title variation 0/5 (unique_titles=1, entropy 0.0) falsifies title-aware PMI viability on TodoMVC in this setting, replicating EXP-PHYSICS-34266105229 degeneracy; pipeline validated by 5 distinct Wikipedia titles on same code path. Maximum justified claim: TodoMVC hash-SPAs are suitable testbeds for URL-level non-leakage PMI at NL scale, but title-aware PMI remains untestable there and requires title-varying production SPAs (still unidentified) or non-title state representation. No inference to history-routed production SPAs, auth-gated flows, or per-URL title variance.
